description.value:
Intelligent weapon characters are people whose true form is a magic weapon, with a spark of life and agency that lets them break beyond what an "item" can do. Their weapon body is always Tiny, but most heritages let them act through a projected avatar, a possessed body, a symbiotic wielder, or by wielding themselves.

Hit Points 8. Size see heritage (Tiny weapon; effectively Small or Medium when active). Speed 25 feet. Ability Boosts Constitution, free. Traits Construct, Intelligent Weapon. Low-Light Vision.

Arsenals (philosophies): battleseekers, embodied, itemspeakers, ramblers, smiths and upgraders.

Versatile heritage: if you take one, decide whether you have a wielder. If not, use the animated weapon rules but you can't float (you slide along the ground). If you do, use the possessing, projecting or symbiotic rules without their special benefit.

See Battlezoo Ancestries: Classic Creatures for the full ancestry.
